description_sq: Ne Myslym Shyri, Shitet Apartament 3+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte!! title_en: In Myslym Shyri, 3+1 apartment for sale with perfect layout!!
description_en: In Myslym Shyri, 3+1 apartment for sale with perfect layout!! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a well-managed 6-story building without an elevator and is organized into a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, three bedrooms and a bathroom with a window. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most favorite areas of Tirana, making it a very good opportunity for both investment and residence. The property has a net surface of 78 m2 and has regular mortgage documentation.
